pins.name: GPIO12
pins.label: GPIO12 (Button)
pins.notes:
BUTTON_A — onboard general-purpose pushbutton, active-low. Not declared in this board's own pins_arduino.h (no static-const alias); confirmed by direct analogy to the RP2040 sibling pimoroni_plasma2040 (identical GPIO12/rp-hal-boards-sourced finding, same upstream lib.rs cited by both files' header comments, identical pin layout carried over from the 2040 board).
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO13
pins.label: GPIO13 (Button)
pins.notes:
BUTTON_B — onboard general-purpose pushbutton, active-low. Same rationale/sourcing as GPIO12 (see pimoroni_plasma2040 sibling).
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO14
pins.label: GPIO14
pins.notes:
CLK — screw-terminal clock line for external APA102/Dotstar LED strip output. Confirmed general-purpose (not dedicated silicon) on the RP2040 sibling; not declared in this board's own pins_arduino.h, added via chipGpios by direct analogy to the sibling.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO15
pins.label: GPIO15
pins.notes:
DAT — screw-terminal data line for external WS2812/Neopixel and APA102/Dotstar LED strip output. This board's own pins_arduino.h PIN_NEOPIXEL(15) alias, but despite the name it drives the EXTERNAL strip connector (confirmed on the RP2040 sibling), not an onboard NeoPixel. No led_neopixel tag.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO16
pins.label: GPIO16 (Led Red active low)
pins.notes:
LED_R — onboard status RGB LED red channel, active-low. Confirmed via this board's own pins_arduino.h PIN_LED_R(16), matching the RP2040 sibling's rp-hal-boards-confirmed value/polarity exactly.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO17

pins.notes:

pins.name: GPIO23
pins.label: GPIO23 (Button)
pins.notes:
USER_SW — third onboard button, doubles as the BOOT-select switch but confirmed freely reusable as a plain input by running code on the RP2040 sibling, no diode-isolation documented. Not declared in this board's own pins_arduino.h; added via chipGpios by direct analogy to the sibling.
Check if available on board
